   "US equities fell again on Thursday. The S&P 500 closed down 2% and the Nasdaq Composite down 2.3%. The sell-off continued in Asia on Friday, with the Nikkei 225 down over 5% and Taiwan's benchmark index down 6.2%.",

   "UBS does not think the economic expansion, the corporate earnings cycle or the structural AI investment story has broken. The 2027 base case is near-trend growth, rising profits, more AI investment and moderating inflation later in the year.",

The Eurozone is the preferred region (15% 2027 earnings growth forecast, lower valuation than the US).
